profile.name: Chris Avery
profile.summary: B2B marketing manager with seven years in software, focused on demand generation and product launches. I manage budgets, run small teams and report pipeline numbers to sales leadership every week.

descriptions: Own a $1.4M annual demand generation budget across paid search, events and webinars; marketing-sourced pipeline grew 46% in 2025
Led the launch of the company's mid-market product with sales and product; it closed $2.2M in its first two quarters
Manage two marketing specialists and an agency, and set the quarterly plan with the VP of Sales
Ran email nurture programs in Marketo for 60,000 contacts; lead-to-meeting conversion rose from 3.1% to 5.4%
Rebuilt the website's pricing and demo pages with the design team, raising demo requests by 38%
Wrote 30 customer case studies by interviewing users and their account managers
Coordinated logistics and email invitations for about 40 corporate events a year
Marketing: Demand generation, product launches, email, paid search, events
Tools: HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce, Google Ads, Google Analytics
Certifications: Google Ads Search, HubSpot Marketing Software
